anomalies.observed: The netlist places every listed VDD pin on its own unconnected net; FCC1.21 (VDDA) and NAVC1.13 (VDDA) are also not on the 3.3 V rail, and NAVC1.12 (VSSA) is unconnected. The +3.3V net includes peripherals but no MCU VDD pins.
anomalies.expected: Both MCUs' VDD and analog supply pins must be connected to the specified 3.3 V supply, with their analog grounds connected appropriately.

evidence.quote: 3.3 V feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs

anomalies.impact: The MCU supply pins are not powered in the represented connectivity, so the flight-control and navigation processors cannot operate as intended.

anomalies.observed: The nets named UART3_TX_FCC and UART3_RX_FCC connect the UART3 connector pins directly to FCC1 pins 48 and 73, which the netlist identifies as VCAP pins.
anomalies.expected: UART signals should use MCU UART-capable signal pins. VCAP pins are internal-regulator supply outputs and should have the required decoupling capacitors, not be used as UART connections.
anomalies.impact: The UART3 connector is not connected to UART signals, and loading the MCU's VCAP outputs may disrupt its internal core supply and prevent reliable operation.

anomalies.observed: The FCC crystal network connects to FCC1.5 (PE6) and FCC1.37 (PE7), rather than its PH0/PH1 oscillator pins. The NAVC HSE crystal nets have no NAVC1 connection; NAVC1.5 (PH0) and NAVC1.6 (PH1) instead connect to separate capacitors to ground.
anomalies.expected: The stated 25 MHz HSE crystals should connect to each MCU's HSE oscillator input and output pins (PH0 and PH1).
anomalies.impact: Neither MCU's HSE crystal is correctly connected, so the intended external clock source will not operate; the processors may fall back to another clock source or fail clock-dependent operation.
